description: Guided Disease Progression flow (per active disease): pure React-free reducer under src/logic/guided-disease/, a portal overlay GuidedDiseasePanel + opt-in GuidedDiseaseTrigger, and host wiring inside DiseasePanel. Mirrors src/logic/guided-cast/ + GuidedCastPanel hosted by SpellCastingPanel. Strictly additive: DiseasePanel's existing handleSymptomTest auto-roll and handleGangreneLocation stay byte-for-byte unchanged; the only new default-render DOM is one trigger per rendered active-disease row. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 (no shared new module); build it first because the disease flow exercises the full pattern (per-symptom iteration, seeded RollDialog, Gangrene close-and-return hand-off, tooltips) that FEAT-002 reuses.
steps: Create src/logic/guided-disease/types.ts: DiseaseStep = 'overview' | 'symptoms' | 'duration'; DiseaseFlowState { step: DiseaseStep; diseaseId: number | null }; DiseaseFlowEvent = {kind:'start';diseaseId:number} | {kind:'next'} | {kind:'back'} | {kind:'goto';step:DiseaseStep} | {kind:'reset'}; DiseaseStepInfo { step; title; body; citation }; DiseaseAdvisorSource.describe(step, ctx:{hasSeedableSymptom:boolean; durationReached:boolean}): DiseaseStepInfo | Promise<DiseaseStepInfo> (sync-or-async union, mirroring CastAdvisorSource in src/logic/guided-cast/types.ts). React-free, JSON-serializable. Header comment cites Core p.186-188 and states the guide re-derives no mechanic.

Create src/logic/guided-disease/reducer.ts mirroring src/logic/guided-cast/reducer.ts: export STEP_SEQUENCE = ['overview','symptoms','duration'] as const; initialDiseaseFlowState = { step:'overview', diseaseId:null }; guidedDiseaseReducer(state, event) pure/total/spread-copy, never throws on frozen state. Transitions: start -> {...initialDiseaseFlowState, step:'overview', diseaseId:event.diseaseId}; next/back clamp within STEP_SEQUENCE (no wrap, return SAME reference when unchanged); goto -> jump to named step (no-op if same); reset -> {...initialDiseaseFlowState}; default exhaustiveness guard returns state. No applicableSteps filtering (fixed 3-step sequence). No auto-advance.

Create src/logic/guided-disease/steps.ts: describeDiseaseStep(step, ctx) returning static rulebook-cited prose for overview / symptoms / duration with verbatim // Core p.186-188 citations (Incubation/Duration p.186; symptom tests p.187-188; Lingering outcomes p.188). Include a // Core p.188: printed Wounded '(+20)' conflicts with Easy=+40; deferring to getSymptomTest comment (A-3). No invented TN/cost/threshold in copy. export const defaultDiseaseAdvisor: DiseaseAdvisorSource = { describe: describeDiseaseStep }.

Add src/logic/guided-disease/__tests__/reducer.test.ts (unit) and reducer.property.test.ts (fast-check) mirroring src/logic/guided-cast/__tests__/. Unit: start -> overview + bound diseaseId; next/back walk overview->symptoms->duration and clamp/idempotent at ends; goto jumps; reset returns a fresh (not same-reference) initial. Property: step always in STEP_SEQUENCE after <=40 random events; nav keeps step in-sequence+clamped; next-from-last/back-from-first are reference-identical no-ops; reset from any arbitrary state deep-equals initialDiseaseFlowState; determinism; frozen-state safety; only start sets diseaseId and reset clears it; no implicit advance past step 1.

Create src/components/shared/GuidedDiseaseTrigger.tsx (+ .module.css) mirroring GuidedCastTrigger.tsx: native <button>, lucide Stethoscope icon (NOT HeartPulse, which DiseasePanel already uses), 'Guide me through this' label on desktop / icon-only on mobile via useMediaQuery('(max-width: 767px)'), aria-label='Guide me through this disease', data-testid='guided-disease-trigger'; onClick calls e.stopPropagation() then onOpen(diseaseId) (onOpen: (diseaseId:number)=>void).

Create src/components/shared/GuidedDiseasePanel.tsx (+ .module.css copied verbatim from GuidedCastPanel.module.css class structure). Copy the GuidedCastPanel scaffold: createPortal to document.body; role='dialog' aria-modal + aria-label; focus trap on Tab/Shift+Tab; previousFocusRef capture + restore on close; focus to step <h2 tabIndex={-1} aria-current='step'> on open and each step change via requestAnimationFrame; ArrowRight/ArrowLeft -> next/back; Esc + backdrop -> close; numbered <ol> stepper with per-step goto + aria-current; polite aria-live region; sheet/drawer variant via useMediaQuery. Consume defaultDiseaseAdvisor as the source object; narrow info instanceof Promise ? null : info. Props include character, the bound ActiveDisease, state, dispatch, onSeedRoll({name,def,difficulty}), onClose. Step bodies: Step1 Overview — read-only timing summary from getDiseaseProgress + RolledTiming.breakdown, point at the existing DiseasePanel timing-roll control, mount NO second TimingRoll (Finding 5); Step2 Symptoms — for each getDiseaseSymptoms entry show description/effect/cadence, and where getSymptomTest(symptom.name, symptom.severity) is non-null render a one-tap seed button calling onSeedRoll (def {kind:'skill',skillName:test.skill,fallbackChar:test.skill==='Endurance'?'T':'WP'}, difficulty test.difficulty, name `${test.skill} (${diseaseName})`); for Gangrene show getToughnessBonus threshold + a close-and-return hand-off button for the Hit-Location roll and seed NOTHING for it (Finding 6); null-test symptoms show guidance only; Step3 Duration/outcome — Lingering Endurance test seedable via onSeedRoll (difficulty getLingeringDifficulty), consequences (extend 1d10 days / Festering Wound / Blood Rot) guidance-only. The panel performs no math and mutates nothing.

Add calculated-total tooltips to GuidedDiseasePanel (calculated-totals steering, FR-6): manage a single openTooltipId + anchor state and render each total through TooltipTriggerCell + Tooltip with an additive labeled breakdown — symptom-test base target and Lingering base target from resolveSeededTarget(character, def).lines; Gangrene TB threshold from getToughnessBonus with its TB component line; rolled Incubation/Duration total reusing RolledTiming.breakdown. No number recomputed by hand.

Host the guide in src/components/shared/DiseasePanel.tsx (additive): add useReducer(guidedDiseaseReducer, initialDiseaseFlowState), guideDiseaseId:number|null, rollDialogState:{name;baseTarget;difficulty}|null. Render one GuidedDiseaseTrigger per active-disease row inside styles.diseaseDetails; onOpen=(id)=>{ setGuideDiseaseId(id); dispatchGuide({kind:'start',diseaseId:id}); } (opening a different id rebinds+resets, AC-2). Render GuidedDiseasePanel only when a disease is bound AND rollDialogState==null (yield for one-aria-modal). onSeedRoll does const { total } = resolveSeededTarget(character, def); setRollDialogState({name, baseTarget: total, difficulty}) and renders the shared RollDialog with defaultDifficulty; onRoll=(r)=>{ onRoll?.(r); setRollDialogState(null); } (uses the existing onRoll prop already threaded from NotesTab). Do NOT touch handleSymptomTest / handleGangreneLocation (stay unchanged). In handleRemoveDisease, if the removed id is the bound guide id, dispatch reset + clear guideDiseaseId + close. Panel close dispatches reset, clears guideDiseaseId, restores focus to the trigger.

Add src/components/shared/__tests__/GuidedDiseaseTrigger.test.tsx (mirror GuidedCastTrigger.test.tsx): renders the native button with data-testid/aria-label; onClick calls onOpen; stopPropagation does not toggle the parent row.

Add src/components/shared/__tests__/GuidedDiseasePanel.steps.test.tsx and GuidedDiseasePanel.integration.test.tsx (RTL, mirror GuidedCastPanel.*.test.tsx). Cover: opt-in off by default (DiseasePanel renders no overlay; a 2-active-disease character renders exactly 2 guided-disease-trigger elements — count equals rows, Finding 9); open/bind/reset (AC-2); Esc/backdrop/close return focus to the trigger (AC-4); RAW order overview->symptoms->duration (AC-5); seed-vs-guidance (AC-6/7/8/9): a seedable symptom opens RollDialog with read-only base target equal to getSymptomTestBaseTarget and difficulty defaulting to the symptom difficulty and opening/rolling mutates nothing (updateCharacter not called with a character change); a null-test symptom shows guidance only; Gangrene shows 'Daily (fail > TB times = lose location)' with the getToughnessBonus figure, renders no location control, seeds no location roll, hand-off closes the guide (Finding 6); Step3 Lingering seeds a RollDialog with consequences as copy; tooltips (AC-14) — symptom base-target TooltipTriggerCell opens a Tooltip containing the resolveSeededTarget lines; modal (AC-18/19) — while the seeded RollDialog is open exactly one role='dialog' aria-modal exists and focus returns to the step heading after close; focus trap / heading focus / arrow nav / numbered stepper aria-current / polite live region.
acceptance_criteria: guidedDiseaseReducer is pure, total, frozen-state-safe, and reset from any state deep-equals initialDiseaseFlowState (asserted by fast-check property tests).
With the guide closed, DiseasePanel renders identically to today apart from one guided-disease-trigger per rendered active-disease row, and all pre-existing DiseasePanel tests pass UNCHANGED.
Activating the disease trigger opens the overlay bound to that disease at Step 1; activating for a different disease rebinds and resets to Step 1; Esc/backdrop/close return focus to the trigger.
The flow presents exactly, in order: Overview, Per-symptom resolution, Duration/outcome guidance.

A seedable symptom opens RollDialog with a read-only base target equal to getSymptomTestBaseTarget and a difficulty select defaulting to the symptom difficulty; opening and rolling mutate nothing on the character; a null-test symptom shows guidance only; Gangrene surfaces the getToughnessBonus threshold and a close-and-return Hit-Location hand-off and seeds no location roll.
Every calculated total in the panel (symptom/Lingering base target, Gangrene TB threshold, rolled timing totals) renders a Tooltip breakdown with additive components.
While the seeded RollDialog is open exactly one aria-modal dialog exists; focus returns to the step heading after it closes.
npx tsc --build --force --noEmit is clean and npm run build compiles.
findings:
Implemented. New modules: src/logic/guided-disease/{types,reducer,steps}.ts (+ __tests__/reducer.{test,property.test}.ts), src/components/shared/GuidedDiseaseTrigger.tsx (+ .module.css), GuidedDiseasePanel.tsx (+ .module.css), and tests GuidedDiseaseTrigger.test.tsx / GuidedDiseasePanel.{steps,integration}.test.tsx. DiseasePanel.tsx hosts the guide additively (useReducer + guideDiseaseId + rollDialogState + shared RollDialog); handleSymptomTest/handleGangreneLocation untouched.

Reuse notes for FEAT-002: (1) GuidedDiseasePanel reuses the shared BreakdownTotal helper at src/components/shared/guidedCastSteps/BreakdownTotal.tsx for every calculated-total tooltip (self-contained open state, wraps Tooltip+TooltipTriggerCell) — reuse it rather than re-rolling a tooltip. (2) The host→guide seam is SeedRollRequest {name; def: ReminderTest; difficulty} exported from GuidedDiseasePanel.tsx; host does `const {total}=resolveSeededTarget(character,def); setRollDialogState({name,baseTarget:total,difficulty})` and renders RollDialog with defaultDifficulty, onRoll=(r)=>{onRoll?.(r); setRollDialogState(null)}. (3) One-aria-modal invariant is enforced by rendering the guide only when `rollDialogState==null` (yield). (4) The opt-in trigger renders inside the expanded-row details block, so only the expanded row shows a trigger (DiseasePanel expands one row at a time) — Finding 9's 'count equals rendered rows' is tested by expanding each row and asserting exactly 1 trigger. (5) CorruptionCard currently has NO onRoll prop and NotesTab does not thread one into it — FEAT-002 must add the optional onRoll prop to CorruptionCard and thread addRoll from NotesTab (DiseasePanel already receives it).

Rulebook citations verified against docs/WarhammerFantasyRoleplay4e.md: disease fields Core p.186; symptoms Core p.187-188; Lingering end-of-duration outcomes (extend 1d10 / Festering Wound / Blood Rot) Core p.188; Gangrene daily Average(+20) Endurance, fail > TB times loses the location (Core p.188); the Wounded printed 'Easy (+20)' conflict is deferred to getSymptomTest (difficulty 'Easy') per A-3 and noted in steps.ts.

Verification (all clean): npx tsc --build --force --noEmit; vitest --run src/logic/guided-disease (18); the three FEAT UI suites (trigger/steps/integration) pass; collateral CorruptionCard.test / NotesTab.test / DiseasePanel.test unchanged and green (combined run 70 passed); npx eslint . = 0 errors (3 pre-existing react-refresh warnings in unrelated files, none in new files); npm run build compiles.
